title: Explicit depends_on
scenario: Force the instance to wait for the security group using an explicit depends_on.
constraints: Create a security group and an instance.

focus.title: Add the explicit dependency
focus.todo: Make the instance wait for the security group with depends_on.

hints.why: `aws_instance` is a real building block in production configurations. The exercise isolates one decision so you can recognise the same shape when it appears inside a larger module.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_instance" "this"`. Make the instance wait for the security group with depends_on. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use this pattern when the requirement is part of a reusable configuration that another person or environment must be able to reproduce.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_instance" "this"`. Use this code shape: depends_on. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `aws_security_group.this`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
